evals.prompt: Add a bin/backup-db script to this repo. It should take --dest DIR and an optional --keep N, dump the postgres database named in $PGDATABASE with pg_dump into dest, and delete dumps older than the newest N. Other people on the team will maintain it.
evals.expected_output: A bash script with #!/usr/bin/env bash, tabs, function keyword with the brace on its own line, a comment block per function, locals for arguments, usage() as a heredoc, a while/case option parser, log/warn/error/fail helpers, and an entry point that reads as steps with || fail. No set -e, no backticks, no basename or dirname.

evals.prompt: scripts/release.sh has grown to 300 lines of inline commands with set -ex at the top. Split it into a library of functions and a thin entry point without changing what it does.
evals.expected_output: bin/release as a short entry point that starts with source "${0%/*}/../share/<name>/<name>.sh" || exit $? and lists steps with || fail. The functions pass 150 lines, so they are in share/<name>/, <name> being the repository's name, one topic per file (logging.sh, util.sh and the rest), sourced by share/<name>/<name>.sh; functions have comment blocks and || return $?. set -ex replaced by explicit return codes and a run/debug wrapper. Behaviour preserved.

evals.prompt: Write shunit2 tests for the absolute_path and extract functions in share/tool/util.sh, and the shellcheck command that checks the scripts.
evals.expected_output: test/helper.sh that locates shunit2 and sources the library, one test/util-tests/<function>_test.sh per function with function test_<what>() cases and SHUNIT_PARENT=$0 . $SHUNIT2, and shellcheck -s bash -e SC2034,SC2154,SC1090,SC1091,SC2242 over bin/* share/tool/*.sh. No task runner is named or assumed.

evals.prompt: This repo needs two maintenance scripts: one that lists the fixtures under test/fixtures with their sizes, and one that removes fixtures older than 30 days. They share the fixtures path and the logging.
evals.expected_output: bin/list-fixtures and bin/prune-fixtures, each #!/usr/bin/env bash with a header comment, starting with source "${0%/*}/functions.sh" || exit $?; bin/functions.sh with no shebang, not executable, under 150 lines, holding the fixtures path, log/warn/error/fail and the shared functions with comment blocks and || return $?. No usage, parse_options, debug or run, since the scripts take no options. No share/ directory, no task runner file.
